what.text: This page follows refugees from Antigua and Barbuda in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 97 refugees from Antigua and Barbuda, and Canada hosted 67.0% of them.
After Canada, the largest hosts are the United Kingdom, the United States and Australia.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Antigua and Barbuda, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2016 to 2021 and 2023 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2001 at 5 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 117, at the end of 2019, and was lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
